name: Mini-Games
description: Quick rounds of memory, words, reflexes and numbers. Everyone gets a chance to shine.
bandHint: Players in easier groups get a gentler challenge (smaller boards, easier words and sums, extra lives, a bigger reaction window), so everyone has a fair shot.

steps: Everyone plays a short game on their own phone at the same time. Before each game you get a how-to and a countdown.
Players in an easier group get an easier version, so everyone has a fair shot.
Race mode ranks you against each other. Play together mode adds everyone's scores into one group total to beat.
rules.scoring: Race: 1st place 10 points, 2nd 7, 3rd 5, everyone else 3. Play together: the group total is saved as a record.
